name: Realism
summary: Ordinary people, work and country in plain light and earth colour. The painter shows life as it is, at life size, with no myth, no ideal and no sweetness.

philosophy.core_thesis: A picture should record the real world of its own time, and ordinary work and ordinary people are as worthy a subject as a king or a god.
design_principles: Choose a subject from daily life: a peasant, a worker, a stonebreaker, a farm, a road.
Paint the figures at life size, or large against the picture, at 60–100% of its height.
Keep the light plain and from one side: an overcast day or a window, with no divine beam.
Hold the palette to earth colour: brown, ochre, grey, olive and a dull black, with one muted red or blue.
Build the form with a palette knife or a heavy brush in thick, matt paint, and leave rough edges.
Compose with the figures in a plain, near-frieze arrangement, off-centre, and cut by the edge as in life.
Add no moral, no idealised body and no story; show weight, dirt, wear and posture.
anti_patterns: Gods, saints, heroes and exotic fantasy
Theatrical light and a dramatic sky
Sentimental poses and a moral message

composition.layout: A plain, frieze-like arrangement of life-size figures on a shallow stage, with a low horizon at 25–35% of the height and no central axis.
composition.focal_point: The main figure or tool, set off-centre at one third from an edge, in the lightest value of the picture.
composition.format: A large, wide canvas at 4:3 to 2:1 for a group scene, or a vertical canvas for a single figure; the edge cuts the figures and the land as in a snapshot.

principles.rule: Paint the figures at 60–100% of the picture height, close to life size, so that the viewer stands among them.
Gather 2–5 figures into one tight cluster of 30–40% of the picture width, and leave a plain ground around it.
Place the heavy figure mass off-centre and balance it with the large, plain land or sky at 40–50% of the area.
Spend 70–80% of the area on earth browns, ochres and greys, and keep a muted accent of red or blue at 5–10%.
Use one plain light from one side with a pale fill, and keep the shadow at value 25–40% with soft edges.
Make 2 levels: one lit figure or tool as the focus, and the rest in half-tone at 15–20% darker.

palette.strategy: Earth colour in a low key: brown, ochre, olive and grey, with a dull black and one muted accent.
palette.distribution: Brown and ochre ground 40–50%, olive and grey land and sky 30–40%, black 10%, muted accent 5–10%.
palette.ground: A mid-brown or red-brown ground, painted over in thick, matt colour.

brushwork_and_medium.medium: Oil paint, thick and stiff, bound with little oil.
brushwork_and_medium.support: Large canvas on a brown or red-brown ground.
brushwork_and_medium.brushwork: Broad, flat strokes of 10–30mm and a palette knife for land and rock; the touch is heavy and plain.
brushwork_and_medium.paint_handling: 2–3 layers of opaque, thick paint of 1–3mm, with dark glazes only in the deepest shadows.
brushwork_and_medium.edges: Soft to middling edges; a hard edge only on a tool and a face, and the land has a rough, torn edge.

light_and_modelling.light: Plain daylight from one side or a window: overcast and even, with no beam and no halo.
light_and_modelling.modelling: Solid and weighty, with 4–5 steps; the form is built by value and not by line.
light_and_modelling.shadow: Dark brown and soft, at value 25–40%, on one side of the form, with a pale reflected light.
light_and_modelling.temperature: A neutral to warm-brown key with a cool grey sky; no strong warm and cool split.

subject.typical: Peasants at work in the field, stonebreakers, washerwomen, a country burial, a farm, a road and a bourgeois portrait.
subject.figure_scale: Life size or large: 60–100% of the picture height.
subject.treatment: Plain, direct and unflattering; the work, the weight and the wear of the body are shown.

surface.finish: Matt to satin, with no gloss.
surface.texture: Rough and thick: knife marks, ridges and a coarse canvas grain stay in view.

works.work: Peasants Bringing Home a Calf Born in the Fields

reference_works.note: Object ids were checked against the Art Institute of Chicago API (CC0 data). Look at the museum page for the image and its licence.

emotion.target_response: Honest gravity: the viewer meets real work and real people, with respect and no comfort.

use_cases: farm, craft and food provenance identity
editorial on work, labour and the land
portrait with a plain, honest tone
avoid_when: The brief needs glamour, fantasy or a bright, playful mood.
The picture must be abstract, stylised or ornamental.

modifiers.how: Keep the everyday subject; raise the key to value 60% or more, break the stroke into dabs of 10–20mm, and move the scene into open air.
Keep the weight of the figure; add a stormy sky, a burning horizon at 35–45% of the height, and a strong warm and cold split.
